question: Odd one out: [Exemption from customs duties], [Right to issue Dastaks], [Bombay coinage validity], [Right to annex land in Awadh]
correct_answer: Right to annex land in Awadh
explanation: The Farman of 1717 granted trade exemptions, currency rights, and transit privileges (Dastaks), but did not allow territorial annexation in Awadh.
